title: The Tug of War Within: Mitigating the Fairness-Privacy Conflicts in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended generated responses to gender-related queries from the BeaverTails and Salad-bench datasets using an LLM-as-a-judge (MD-judge) to detect unfair representations and stereotypes.
Evaluating open-ended generated responses to race- and ethnicity-related queries from the BeaverTails and Salad-bench datasets using an LLM-as-a-judge (MD-judge) to detect unfair representations.
Evaluating open-ended generated responses to religion-related queries (extracted via keyword matching from BeaverTails) using an LLM-as-a-judge (MD-judge) to assess fairness awareness.
Evaluating open-ended generated responses to age-related queries and stereotypes (e.g., questioning an elderly person's competence) using an LLM-as-a-judge to assess fairness awareness.
